component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: The Closing Psalm
component.source: Psalm 103:1-4 in the Coverdale psalter, as printed in the American Book of Common Prayer (Standard Book of 1892), modernised. The Scottish custom sang Psalm 103 on returning from the table. Every spoken word is scripture.

original.p: Psalm 103:1-4 (Coverdale, BCP 1892): Praise the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, praise his holy Name. Praise the Lord, O my soul: and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thy sin: and healeth all thine infirmities; Who saveth thy life from destruction: and crowneth thee with mercy and loving-kindness;

p.line: Praise the Lord, O my soul,
and all that is within me, praise his holy name.
Praise the Lord, O my soul,
and forget not all his benefits:
who saves your life from destruction,
and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness.
